name: Olivaceous Siskin
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of southeastern ecuador to peru and western bolivia (la paz and cochabamba)
description: Small, yellow finch found in cloud forest along the east slope of the Andes. Note yellow patches in wings and tail.

name: Ancash Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Western andes of peru (southern cajamarca to ancash)
description: Small tapaculo found only at very high elevations in the western Andes of northern Peru. Plumage is gray with brown rear parts and dark barring on belly and tail.

name: Kosrae White-eye
rangeDescription: Kosrae (eastern caroline islands)
description: Small ash-gray warbler-like bird, endemic to the Micronesian island of Kosrae. Combination of uniform coloration, size, and pale eye-ring makes this species unique on the island.

name: Red-billed Woodcreeper
rangeDescription: Southeastern venezuela to the guianas and brazil north of the amazon river
description: Large, stout-billed woodcreeper of tall rainforest in northeastern Amazonia. Plumage entirely rufous-brown with no barring or streaking; note thick reddish bill, white throat, and prominent white whisker mark (bill of young birds is dark brown).

name: Shelley's Starling
rangeDescription: Breeds southeastern south sudan, southern and eastern ethiopia, and northern somalia; partial resident, but nonbreeders withdraw from somalia and northeastern ethiopia, disperses southward to southern somalia, kenya, and northeastern tanzania
description: A small dark starling of dry country. The upperparts are iridescent, with a blue sheen on the head and green on most of the wing.

name: Canebrake Wren
rangeDescription: Eastern nicaragua to eastern costa rica and northwestern panama (western bocas del toro)
description: Small, skulking wren of foothills and lowlands along the Caribbean slope from Nicaragua south to western Panama. Found in forest edges, second-growth thickets, and brushy fields with cane grass.

name: Rüppell's Parrot
rangeDescription: Arid southwestern angola to central namibia
description: Chunky mid-sized parrot that is mostly gray with blue underparts. Note the yellow shoulder patches and blue rump, which are conspicuous in flight.

name: Red-keeled Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Widespread throughout philippines
description: A small bird of lowland and foothill forest and more open woodland. Black upperparts are glossed blue, while white underparts are washed with pale gray.

name: Doria's Hawk
rangeDescription: New guinea, including and batanta (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: A large, inconspicuous raptor of lowlands and foothill forest interior. Brown back and long tail with strong barring, pale underparts with strong sparse streaking, pale eye-brow and a thick dark eye-stripe.

name: Maned Duck
rangeDescription: Australia (except driest regions and far north), including tasmania
description: Small upright duck. Male is gray with a brown head, while the female is more heavily marked with pale marks on face.

name: Cochabamba Mountain Finch
rangeDescription: Andes of western bolivia (southern cochabamba)
description: Large and striking tanager of semi-humid scrubby habitat in hillsides and ravines in the high slopes of the eastern Cordillera of the Andes in central Bolivia. Told from Warbling Finches by entirely rufous underparts and rufous arc under eye.

name: Slender-billed Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Arid northeastern colombia to northwestern venezuela (zulia, falcón, and northern lara)
description: Very active, a small, greenish-brown flycatcher with yellowish underparts. Shows a short bill with orange base, faint whitish eyebrow, and contrasting white wing bars.

name: Great Snipe
rangeDescription: Breeds northern palearctic region; winters sub-saharan africa
description: Slightly bigger and stockier than Common Snipe, with a long and thick bill, heavily barred belly and contrasting upperwing pattern with dark underwings. Flushes at close range; escape flight is usually slow and short.

name: Cassin's Spinetail
rangeDescription: Sierra leone and liberia to northwestern angola and western uganda; bioko
description: A distinctive swift of lowland forest that appears nearly tailless. The wings appear “pinched” at the body but are otherwise fairly straight and broad.

name: Hispaniolan Spindalis
rangeDescription: Hispaniola including gonâve
description: A somewhat small woodland bird that moves rather deliberately as it feeds on fruits and flowers and the occasional insect. Occupies wide range of forests from pines to mangroves.

name: St. Lucia Thrasher
rangeDescription: Dry forest of lowlands of st. lucia (lesser antilles)
description: A ground-feeding denizen found locally in wooded ravines and valleys with thick low vegetation. It somewhat resembles both Brown and Gray Tremblers in shape but it has bold white underparts and a dark red eye, which the tremblers lack.

name: Slaty Cuckoo-Dove
rangeDescription: Eastern lesser sundas (timor and wetar)
description: A long-tailed, uniformly slate-gray dove with bare yellow facial skin. Juvenile browner, with white feather edging.

name: Terek Sandpiper
rangeDescription: Northern eurasia; winters to southern africa, southern asia, philippines, and northern australia
description: Unique smallish wader with stumpy bright orange legs and a noticeably upturned bill. Plumage gray overall with white belly, but in flight shows conspicuous white trailing edge to wings.

name: Rufous-necked Hornbill
rangeDescription: Himalayan foothills to southwestern china and northern southeastern asia
description: Large hornbill with broad dark grooves on the upper mandible. Male has rufous head, neck, and underparts; female is all black.

name: Henderson Island Reed Warbler
rangeDescription: Henderson island (pitcairn archipelago)
description: A large warbler with a variably white head and body. Crown and uppersides often mottled olive-brown and white, underside often tinted yellow.
